name: Heliconius cydno alithea Forewing Color Blind Retrodiction
purpose: First real-data bridge benchmark for LIFE-CODE predictive infrastructure. Predict a deliberately hidden, binary forewing color phenotype (yellow vs white) for held-out H. cydno alithea males using genomic information while semantic annotation is locked.

scientific_boundary.reason: The published resource already contains genotype/variant and phenotype data. It is therefore ideal for testing blind prediction contracts, but any recovery of the known K-locus/aristaless biology is validation, not novelty.

sources.title: Genetic, developmental, and neural changes underlying the evolution of butterfly mate preference
sources.use: Cohort definition and published phenotype/genomic context

sources.title: Genetic, developmental and neural changes underlying evolving butterfly mate preference
expected_files: genome-wide pruned variant callset / PLINK files (inside gwas archive)

sources.title: H. cydno alithea whole-genome resequencing
sources.use: Optional raw-read escalation path for sequence-native replication

sources.title: Aristaless controls butterfly wing color variation used in mimicry and mate choice

frozen_split_contract.note: Labels may be used by the orchestration layer only to create a balanced split. Held-out phenotype labels are then sealed and unavailable to inference until reveal.

A_bridge_variant_lane.inputs: published reference + pruned genome-wide variant data
A_bridge_variant_lane.goal: prove freeze/render/score/retrodiction machinery on real biology

B_sequence_native_lane.inputs: raw WGS or reconstructed per-subject sequence state
B_sequence_native_lane.goal: repeat benchmark using sequence-native LIFE-CODE structural features

C_cross_taxon_morph_lane.goal: graduate from binary color to spatial morphology retrodiction

reveal_ground_truth.known_mechanism_summary: White/yellow wing coloration maps to the K-locus region; later work identifies regulatory variation around aristaless1 as causal/mechanistically supported. This information is forbidden to the blind inference lane and is used only after freeze.

success_gates: All source files hashed before analysis.
Subject ID mapping resolved without phenotype leakage.
Train/holdout split generated deterministically and frozen.
Held-out truth stored separately; only its SHA-256 visible pre-reveal.
Prediction packet emitted for all 22 holdout subjects.
Primary score is balanced accuracy plus Brier/log-loss style calibration; not visual realism.
Permutation/null labels and phylogeny/population-structure baselines are evaluated.
Post-reveal semantic concordance is recorded as new evidence, never used to rewrite the frozen prediction.
